entities.summary: SmileyWorld Limited, trading as The Smiley Company, is a brand licensing company based in London, United Kingdom. It claims to hold the rights to the smiley face in over 100 countries. The company licenses products including textiles, puzzles, party goods, stationery, automobile accessories, and toys for licensed brand partners and retailers. Franklin Loufrani was a performers & entertainers from Algiers (b. 1942-10-25, Algiers). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
